title: Rav Kahana son of Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So it is in [Nazir 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.43b.7), but Hyman considers the clear plain sense to be that Rav Kahana recited a baraita taught in the school of Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Nazir has Rav Kahana berabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov. Hyman reads the phrase as a citation of a baraita taught in Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov’s school.
The heading follows the apparent patronymic. Hyman expressly prefers the interpretation as a reference to the school.
